Large colorful graphic text overlays appear prominently at the top and bottom of the frame. He picks up a blue cap with a yellow horse-like logo. The camera uses a medium close-up, focusing on his facial expressions and the movement of his hands as he presents the product. The lighting remains high-contrast, emphasizing the textures of the fabric and his skin. (3) A montage sequence follows, showing macro shots of the caps. It features a colorful illustration of two anime characters, a girl in a racing uniform and a boy in a helmet. The camera shows close-up views of the material, demonstrating its texture and the quality of the print. The character's hands are visible manipulating the holder to show the front and back. (6) The final phase shows all the showcased items—four caps, the gold key, and the ID holder—arranged together on the table. A digital QR code appears in the upper right corner of the frame. The camera zooms out slowly as the character gestures towards the items. Final graphic text overlays emphasizing the brand and theme cover the center of the screen.
